description:
Have you ever wondered about the true impact of your prayers on the lives of others? In this video, Pastor Mark Finley will help you discover the truth about intercessory prayer, exploring the biblical foundations and real-world effects of praying for those around us. Lear the transformative power of "how to pray for others" and how it can change destinies, heal wounds, and bring about divine interventions.

Jesus, the Apostle Paul, and many spiritual giants throughout history have emphasized the importance of praying for others. But how exactly do we do it? What should we say? And what can we expect as a result? Join us as we answer these questions and more, providing you with practical steps and insights to enhance your prayer life.
